name: Evaporation
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly controls the natural processes of evaporation, causing vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth as part of His divine orchestration of weather and water cycles. Passages in Psalms and Jeremiah emphasize His power in bringing forth vapors, lightnings, rain, and wind from His heavenly treasuries, demonstrating His authority over creation. Additionally, Amos highlights God's command over the waters of the sea, pouring them out upon the earth, underscoring His role as the Creator who governs all elements of nature for His purposes.
